description: Vorbehaltsgebiet für Wasserversorgung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Reserved areas are areas where there is a technical concern (here: water supply) must be given particular weight when weighing up competing uses. In the regional plans, the regional planning associations define sensitive areas of groundwater catchment areas outside the water protection areas as reserve areas for water supply to the public water supply. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Reserve area for water supply" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Wasser, Regionalplan, gdiby, Versorgung, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 2015-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
